name: real-v1-rotating-holdout
warning: Model-backed benchmark. Hidden tests are excluded from provider context. Use repeated external runs before making research claims.

tasks.description: Fix slugify(text): lowercase, trim, collapse runs of non-alphanumeric characters to one hyphen, and remove edge hyphens.
Fix clamp(value, low, high). It must clamp inclusively and raise ValueError when low > high.
Fix dedupe(items) so it removes duplicates while preserving first-seen order and works for unhashable values such as lists.
Fix chunks(items, size): return consecutive lists of at most size elements; reject size <= 0 with ValueError.
Fix parse_bool(value): accept booleans and common case-insensitive strings true/false, yes/no, 1/0, on/off; otherwise raise ValueError.
Fix safe_div(a,b,default=None): return a/b, but when b is zero return default. Do not hide unrelated exceptions.
Fix median(values): support odd/even lengths without mutating the input; raise ValueError on empty input.
Fix deep_get(mapping,path,default=None): path is dot-separated; traverse dictionaries safely and return default when any segment is missing.
Fix backoff(attempt,base=1.0,cap=60.0): exponential delay base*2**attempt capped at cap; reject negative attempt/base/cap with ValueError.
Fix merge_counts(*mappings): sum numeric values for matching keys without mutating inputs; missing keys count as zero.
